第84章 倒霉催的-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》

小心翼翼的打开房门，吴姜不敢发出一丝声响，要是被家里的老虎知道，他这么晚才回来，少不了挨顿收拾。

万幸的是，客厅里一片漆黑，老爷子、吴时安和王雅琴都已经睡下了，只有客厅里留着一盏微弱的小夜灯。

吴姜麻溜的跑回自己房间，先给给念念点了一炷香，之后，也没洗澡，上床就睡了。

第二天是大年三十，按照习俗，一家人要在一起包饺子，辞旧迎新。

吴姜被客厅里的动静吵醒，揉着惺忪的睡眼起床，洗漱完毕后，也加入了包饺子的队伍。

他除了不会擀皮，包的饺子却是个个饱满圆润，整齐好看，而且速度很快，可谓是今天包饺子的主力。

老爷子坐在一旁，看着吴姜熟练的动作，时不时地夸上几句：“我乖孙就是厉害，什么都会，比你爸强多了！”

吴时安正低头擀皮，听到老爷子的话，脸上瞬间露出郁闷的神色，却又不敢反驳，只能默默加快手里的速度，心里暗自较劲，嘴上却不敢吭声。

饺子快要包完的时候，吴姜的手机突然响了起来，看了一眼来电显示，是李强打来的。

吴姜拍了拍手上的面粉，直接将手机开了外放，笑着问道：“喂，强子，怎么了？”

“吴姜，早上我想起你昨天说的话，就试着给我表哥打了个电话，谁知道我表哥立马就同意了，一个劲地催我请你帮忙介绍，还说最好今天就让大师过去他那边！”

得，吴姜估计，李强的表哥估计真的快顶不住了，属于病急乱投医，只要有一丝希望，什么方法都想试试。

“强子，你也不看看今天是什么日子，大年三十啊，大师也是要过年的。”

李强这才反应过来，也有些不好意思地说道：“确实哈，换我今天也不去，那年后能不能请大师去一趟深市？我表哥那边是真的撑不住了，再拖下去，公司就彻底垮了。”

“你别着急，我帮你联系一下赵大师，问问他的意思，具体怎么安排，还要听他怎么说。”吴姜安慰道，“我这边联系好，就立马告诉你。”

挂了李强的电话，吴姜立刻拨通了赵安坤的电话。

Opening the door carefully, Wu Jiang did not dare to make a sound. If the tiger at home knew that he came back so late, he would have to be cleaned up.

Fortunately, the living room was dark. The old man, Wu Shi'an and Wang Yaqin had all fallen asleep. There was only a weak night light left in the living room.

Wu Jiangma quickly ran back to her room, first lit a stick of incense for Nian Nian, and then went to bed without taking a shower.

The next day is New Year's Eve. According to custom, the family makes dumplings together to bid farewell to the old year and welcome the new year.

Wu Jiang was awakened by the movement in the living room. He rubbed his sleepy eyes and got up. After washing, he also joined the dumpling-making team.

Apart from not being able to roll out the dough, the dumplings he makes are plump, round, neat and beautiful, and he is very fast. He can be said to be the main force in making dumplings today.

The old man sat aside, watching Wu Jiang's skillful movements, and complimented him from time to time: "My good grandson is amazing, he can do everything, he is much better than your dad!"

Wu Shi'an was lowering his head to roll out the dough. When he heard the old man's words, a depressed look appeared on his face, but he did not dare to refute. He could only speed up his hands silently, secretly competing in his heart, but he did not dare to say a word.

When the dumplings were about to be wrapped, Wu Jiang's cell phone suddenly rang. He glanced at the caller ID and saw that it was Li Qiang.

Wu Jiang patted the flour on his hands, turned on the phone, and asked with a smile: "Hey, Qiangzi, what's wrong?"

"Wu Jiang, this morning I remembered what you said yesterday, so I tried to call my cousin. Who knew that my cousin immediately agreed and kept urging me to ask you to help introduce me? He also said that it would be best to ask the master to go to his place today!"

Well, Wu Jiang estimated that Li Qiang's cousin was really almost unable to bear it anymore. He was in a hurry and sought medical treatment. As long as there was a glimmer of hope, he would try any method.

"Qiangzi, don't look at what day it is today. It's New Year's Eve. Master is also celebrating the New Year."

Only then did Li Qiang react and said with some embarrassment: "Indeed, I wouldn't go today. Can you please ask the master to go to Shenzhen City in the next year? My cousin really can't hold on. If it continues, the company will completely collapse."

"Don't worry, I'll help you contact Master Zhao and ask him what he means and how to arrange it specifically. You also need to listen to what he has to say." Wu Jiang comforted, "I'll tell you right away once I get in touch."

After hanging up Li Qiang's phone, Wu Jiang immediately dialed Zhao Ankun's number.
